scope: Native snapshot/bind/bootstrap/default-table/tick ABI; actual registry timestamp adapter/thunk and memory code, default/custom backends, early return, callbacks and incoming-R1/payload quirks
limitations: Native bootstrap/binder/default accessor/tick spans are supplemental and absent from ownership/pseudocode inventory. Missing Ghidra function boundary is preserved; Thumb and native differential execution provide their contracts.
